# Core Hermit Privacy Policy

_Effective September 29, 2026_

Core Hermit is designed to work without collecting your data. This policy explains what happens to information when you use the app.

## The short version
- We do **not** collect, store, sell, or share your personal data.
- There are **no accounts, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking**.
- Your chats, documents, and voice input are processed **on your device** and stay there.

## Information stored on your device
Your conversations, imported documents (and their search index), settings, and downloaded AI models are stored only in Core Hermit's private storage on your device. We cannot access them. You can delete individual chats, documents, and models in the app, and deleting the app removes all of it. Depending on your device settings, iOS may include some of this data in your own encrypted iCloud or device backups, which are governed by Apple.

## Performance measurements
To show how fast each model runs, Core Hermit records performance numbers for each AI reply: which model answered, response times, answer length, prompt size, and device conditions (temperature, Low Power Mode, charging). These records contain **no prompt or answer text**, are kept on your device for up to 90 days, and are never sent anywhere. You can turn this off or clear the history in Settings › Benchmarks. Benchmark results you choose to share (as an image or CSV file) contain only these numbers, your device model and iOS version.

## Quality comparisons
If you use Compare Quality, Core Hermit saves each question you compared, both models' answers and your vote, so you can review them later. They're stored **only on your device** and are never sent anywhere. You can delete one comparison by swiping it in Compare › Quality, or all of them in Settings › Benchmarks.

## AI processing
- **Apple Intelligence** responses are generated on-device using Apple's Foundation Models framework. Core Hermit does not use Apple's Private Cloud Compute or any other server-based model.
- **Open models** run on-device using Apple's MLX framework.
- Your prompts and the AI's responses are never sent to us or to any AI service.

## Voice
If you use voice mode, microphone audio is converted to text on your device (speech recognition is set to on-device only), and spoken replies are generated on your device. Audio is not recorded to storage or uploaded. Microphone and speech-recognition access are optional and can be turned off at any time in iOS Settings.

## Network connections
Core Hermit connects to the internet only when you ask it to download something:
- **AI model files** for the models listed in the app are downloaded from Apple's servers, where Core Hermit publishes them through the App Store. On older iOS versions, and for models you add by name yourself, they're downloaded from Hugging Face (huggingface.co).
- **Custom voice files** are downloaded from web addresses you enter yourself.

As with any download, those servers receive standard technical information such as your IP address and device/network details, handled under their own privacy policies (Apple: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/; Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/privacy). No chat content, documents, or voice data are sent. Links you tap (such as license pages) open in your browser.

## Contacting us
If you email us (for example, to report an AI response), we receive only what you choose to include in the email, plus your email address. We use it solely to respond to you and improve the app, and we don't share it.

## Children
Core Hermit is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

## Your rights
Because we don't collect personal data, there is no personal data held by us to access, correct, or delete. All your data is under your control on your device. If you have questions, contact us.

## Changes
If this policy changes, we'll update the effective date and publish the new version in the app and at https://corehermit.github.io/privacy/.
